alt_text: Seven-slide carousel titled What I check before saying looks good. It lists six review checks in pairs: claims and product, CTA and on-screen words, sound and the brief; explains why claims are checked first; notes that a beautiful video can still fail the brief; and closes with a slide asking readers to follow Galvor.

slides.headline: What I check before saying *looks good*
slides.sub: Six checks on every cut, before it reaches the client.

slides.headline: Claims and *product*
items: Claims — every line matches what the brand approved
Proof — no 'best' or 'number one' without backup
Product — visible, right pack, right variant
Label — facing camera, readable on a phone

slides.headline: CTA and *on-screen words*
items: CTA — one ask, matching the offer that's live
End card — right price, right dates
Supers — spelling, brand name, product name
Subtitles — in sync, readable on a phone

slides.headline: Sound and *the brief*
items: Music — cleared for paid ads, not only organic
Voice — steady levels, no clipped words
Message — the one message the brief asked for
Must-haves — every stated must-have is in the cut

slides.headline: The miss that *costs most*
slides.body:
A wrong subtitle is a quick fix.

A claim the brand never approved can get the ad pulled after it goes live.

So I check claims before anything I enjoy watching.

slides.headline: A beautiful video can still *fail the brief*.
slides.sub: Check the brief last, with fresh eyes.

slides.headline: Run the check *before* you say yes.
slides.sub: Save this for your next review day.

title: Before I say 'looks good': the six-check review
caption:
"Looks good" is the most expensive thing I can say too early.
Once I say it, the video goes to the client, and every miss after that is mine.

So before I say it, I run the same six checks on every cut.

Claims go first, because those are the misses that come back from legal. Then the product, the CTA, the words on screen, the sound, and finally the brief itself.

It felt slow the first few times. After a few weeks it became habit, and it's the same list I'd want any agent to run before it reaches me.

Swipe for the full check. Save it for your next review day.

Follow Galvor for more from the brief-to-live desk.
